conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Special Investigator Cooper speaking. Who am I speaking with, please?
Uh, my name is Helen Patterson. I got a message saying there was some problem with my taxes.

Yes, Mrs. Patterson, I see your file here. Our records indicate a serious discrepancy in your federal tax filings for the years 2019 and 2020. The IRS has flagged your account for immediate attention.
Oh dear, I wasn't aware of any issues. I always try to pay my taxes on time.

I understand, ma'am, but unfortunately, this situation is quite severe. The system shows unpaid back taxes totaling $3,700, which has triggered an arrest warrant for tax fraud. This is a federal offense.
An arrest warrant? I'm 72 years old! I can't go to jail. There must be some mistake.
I wish I could tell you otherwise, but this is a legal matter at this stage. If the debt is not settled today, your Social Security benefits may be frozen and your driver's license suspended.
No, please, I need those benefits to live on! What can I do?
You do have one final opportunity to resolve this outside of court, but it must be handled immediately. Are you able to make payment to clear your tax debt today?
I-I don't have much in my checking account. Is there a way to pay part of it?
If you can make a partial payment now, it will temporarily suspend the warrant. The minimum required is $1,500 today. How much do you have access to at this moment, Mrs. Patterson?
I think I have maybe $1,200 from my savings. Can I pay that?

That will suffice for now. All payments for urgent tax issues are currently processed through secure government-approved methods. You must purchase Target or Best Buy gift cards totaling $1,200 and provide me the codes so we can register your payment.
Gift cards? I thought the IRS wanted checks or bank transfers.
Due to an ongoing audit and security procedures, we cannot accept checks or direct transfers for flagged accounts. Gift cards are the only approved method for immediate resolution at this time.
Alright, I guess I can go to the store. What do I do after I buy them?
Once you have the cards, scratch off the backing and read me each code over the phone. Do not disconnect. This is a time-sensitive matter and must be completed within the next hour.
I understand, I'll leave for the store right now. Please don't let them freeze my benefits.

As long as you follow my instructions and provide the payment codes promptly, your benefits and license will remain active. If you fail to do so, I won't be able to stop the arrest order from proceeding.
Alright, I'm leaving now. I'll call you from the parking lot when I have the cards.
Excellent. Remember, do not discuss this with anyone at the store, this is a confidential federal matter. Call me directly as soon as you have the cards in hand.
